content.title: Proverbs & Ecclesiastes Part 1: Dr. Lincoln Blumell
content.summary: Hosts Hank Smith and John Bytheway interview Dr. Lincoln Blumell, who explores Proverbs and Ecclesiastes with a focus on wisdom, grief, and what fearing God means for both ancient and modern readers. This two-part conversation frames Proverbs as sage parental counsel worth treasuring while wrestling with Ecclesiastes' harder questions.
content.hosts_or_guests: Hank Smith, John Bytheway, Dr. Lincoln Blumell

notes: Also available as Part 2 continuing the discussion (YouTube, Aug 28, 2022): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X0NkSxX_w_E

content.title: Proverbs, Ecclesiastes
content.summary: Emily Belle Freeman and David Butler unpack practical, everyday application of wisdom literature, highlighting themes like "Better is the End of a Thing than the Beginning of it" and a deep dive into Proverbs 31's "Eshet Chayil" (woman of valor). Their conversation blends Hebrew word study with reflections on living "the good life" as taught in Ecclesiastes.

content.title: Come Follow Me – The Book of Proverbs: "The Beginning of Wisdom"
content.summary: Jared Halverson delivers a verse-by-verse, in-depth study of Proverbs as Part 1 of a two-part series covering the wisdom literature, focusing on how wisdom is personified and applied to daily life. The companion Part 2 episode, "Ecclesiastes & Song of Solomon: To Everything There Is a Season," extends the study into Ecclesiastes' themes of vanity and seasons of life.

notes: Part 2 (Ecclesiastes) also available: 'Come Follow Me – Ecclesiastes & Song of Solomon: To Everything There Is a Season' on the Unshaken YouTube channel.

content.title: PART 1 | Proverbs | Aug 29-Sep 4 | Come Follow Me Insights
content.summary: Taylor Halverson and Tyler Griffin (joined by Tyler's wife Kiplin in this special episode) explore words of healing and hope drawn from the wisdom literature for this week's block. A companion Part 2 episode continues the discussion into the second half of the assigned chapters.
content.hosts_or_guests: Taylor Halverson, Tyler Griffin, Kiplin Griffin

content.title: Ep 168 | Proverbs; Ecclesiastes, Come Follow Me (August 29-September 4)
content.summary: Mike Day and Bryce Dunford examine Proverbs and Ecclesiastes as "Wisdom Literature," tracing Egyptian influence on Proverbs, wisdom personified as feminine and as a Tree of Life, and drawing parallels between Nephi's teachings and the Wisdom Tradition. They also discuss the distinction between the wise person and the fool and how truth can be found across religious traditions.
